_about.how: Region cards are copied word for word from the verified "at a glance" facts on the FairExit region pages. Each one carries its official source. Facts with no source, a source we could not open directly, or a topic in the page's "couldn't confirm yet" list are left out.
_about.show_source: Show the source name under each region card as small text, linked to the url.
_about.approval_note: Region facts are pending employment-lawyer sign-off, like the calculator numbers. Do not show region cards in production until this is true; lawyer and report cards are fine.
_about.do_not_edit: Never edit card text by hand. FairExit regenerates this file whenever a region page changes.
